courses.title: Capacity Building for Conservation Teams
courses.description: Capacity Building for Conservation Teams focuses on capacity building for people working toward a Conservation Programme Manager role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces science communication, enough to apply alongside capacity building in real Conservation Programme Manager work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to capacity building and show how science communication supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying capacity building to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing capacity building through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to science communication
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Conservation Policy in Practice
courses.description: Conservation Policy in Practice goes beyond the basics of conservation policy, for people already working toward a Conservation Programme Manager role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in conservation policy and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying conservation policy to a real Conservation Programme Manager scenario
Practicing conservation policy through guided exercises
Building a short conservation policy exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Species Monitoring Protocols Fundamentals walks you through the basics of species monitoring protocols, built for people new to Conservation Programme Manager work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of species monitoring protocols, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
